attempts.thought: Each of the six is built as a self-sufficient win condition so any pick-3 combination works: Dragonite (DD/E-Speed), Gholdengo (Nasty Plot + Recover), Kingambit (SD priority), Annihilape (Bulk Up + Rage Fist) and Garchomp (SD + rocks) all threaten to sweep alone, while Rotom-Wash is the lone defensive pivot with Will-O-Wisp and Volt Switch. Unique items maximize each role: Lum Berry protects Dragonite's boost turn, Life Orb powers Gholdengo, Black Glasses Kingambit's STABs, Leftovers fuels Annihilape, Focus Sash guarantees Garchomp's Stealth Rock, and Rindo Berry covers Rotom-Wash's only weakness (Grass). EV spreads are 32 in the two key stats plus 2 spare, with natures that patch each mon's primary role.
